source.title: Video Edit Critique
source.description: Imported suggestions from the earlier Test 3 critique. No fresh video analysis or MAGIX effect inspection is claimed. Times are approximate export positions, not verified project positions.

notes.title: Simplify the news entrance
notes.observation: The earlier critique describes several competing entrance treatments before the news image settles.
notes.suggestion: Compare a clear [REDACTED] title, a readable RESIST insert, and a decisive cut into the news footage. Let the news image establish itself before another major change.

steps.title: Bring MAGIX forward
steps.instruction: Activate the connected MAGIX window. This changes focus only; it does not change your project.

steps.title: Match the export moment to your project
steps.instruction: Confirm that the project matches Test 3 and locate the title-to-news transition. Save a separately named project copy before editing. These approximate export times do not identify a timeline object automatically.

steps.title: Inspect the current controls
steps.instruction: Refresh Buddy’s list of accessible controls in the connected MAGIX window. This reads the current interface; it does not open an effect panel or change a setting.

steps.title: Try one simpler entrance
steps.instruction: Manually compare removing one competing overlay or entrance treatment at a time. Preserve the title and the news context. Keep only the changes that make the arrival clearer.

steps.title: Compare the result at normal speed
steps.instruction: Preview the section in context, then compare a new export with Test 3. Mark this note reviewed only after checking the result. If timing changed, recheck the other notes against the new revision.

notes.title: Let the pig image resolve
notes.observation: The earlier critique describes bright highlights and overlapping contours that make the pig image difficult to identify.
notes.suggestion: Keep a recognizable primary image beneath the disruption. Compare reducing either the ghost strength or the brightness, one change at a time.

steps.title: Bring MAGIX forward
steps.instruction: Activate the connected MAGIX window. This changes focus only; it does not change your project.

steps.title: Identify the object and its treatment
steps.instruction: Match the export moment to your project and select the affected object. Save a separately named project copy before editing. Identify the actual effect or layers; the export does not reveal the original preset or values.

steps.title: Test one reduction
steps.instruction: Manually reduce either the overlap strength or the brightness, then compare. Keep one clear primary image. These are creative experiments, not measured replacement settings.

steps.title: Check the disturbance and the recovery
steps.instruction: Preview at normal speed. Check whether the subject becomes recognizable after the disturbance. Compare the next export before marking this note reviewed.

notes.title: Give RESIST stronger contrast
notes.observation: The earlier critique describes pale RESIST lettering against bright paper during the news transition. The exact insert boundaries have not been remeasured.
notes.suggestion: If the word should be readable, compare stronger separation between the lettering and background before extending the insert.

steps.title: Bring MAGIX forward
steps.instruction: Activate the connected MAGIX window. This changes focus only; it does not change your project.

steps.title: Check how the word was made
steps.instruction: Find the RESIST insert in the matching project. Check whether the lettering is editable text or baked into an image. Save a separately named project copy before editing.

steps.title: Separate the lettering from the background
steps.instruction: Manually adjust the relevant text or image treatment for stronger contrast. Preserve the intended flash. The correct controls depend on the actual object type and effects.

steps.title: Check readability in context
steps.instruction: Preview at normal speed. Consider a longer hold only if the intended word still fails to register. Compare the next export before marking this note reviewed.
